headline: Nordnet Q3 Profit Climbs 24% Powered by Savings Inflows and Net Interest
summary: Nordic investment platform Nordnet posted a 24% rise in third-quarter profit, benefiting from growing customer net savings inflows and elevated net interest income.
why: Nordnet is a retail investment and savings bank operating across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, and Finland.

impacts.name: Nordnet AB
impacts.why: Net income grew 24% on rising client inflows and sustained interest margins.
